readme:
# Reed.co.uk Scraper

Extract job listings from [Reed.co.uk](https://www.reed.co.uk), the UK's largest job board with 200,000+ live vacancies.

## What data do you get?

Each job listing includes:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| **Title** | Job title |
| **Company** | Hiring company name |
| **Salary** | Min/max salary, currency (GBP), period (year/day/hour) |
| **Location** | Job location (city, region) |
| **Country** | Always `GB` |
| **Employment type** | Permanent, contract, temporary, full-time, part-time |
| **Remote option** | Remote, hybrid, or on-site |
| **Description** | Full job description (text + HTML) in full mode |
| **Posted date** | When the job was posted |
| **Expiry date** | When the listing expires (full mode) |
| **Apply URL** | Direct link to apply |
| **Source URL** | Original Reed.co.uk listing URL |

## How to use

### Option 1: Search URLs
1. Go to [reed.co.uk](https://www.reed.co.uk)
2. Search for any job (e.g., "software engineer in London")
3. Copy the URL from your browser
4. Paste it into the **Search URLs** field

### Option 2: Keywords
Enter job titles or skills in the **Search Keywords** field:
- `software engineer`
- `data analyst`
- `marketing manager`

### Scraping modes

| Mode | Speed | Data | Cost |
|------|-------|------|------|
| **Fast** | ~1 sec/page (25 jobs) | Title, company, salary text, location, type | $3/1K |
| **Full** | ~5 sec/page + details | Everything above + full description, structured salary, expiry date | $5/1K |

## Input examples

### Basic search
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.reed.co.uk/jobs/software-engineer-jobs-in-london"],
  "maxResults": 100,
  "mode": "fast"
}
```

### Multiple keywords with location
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["data scientist", "machine learning engineer"],
  "location": "Manchester",
  "maxResults": 200,
  "mode": "full"
}
```

### Large-scale extraction
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["nurse", "doctor", "healthcare"],
  "maxResults": 1000,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 500,
  "mode": "fast"
}
```

## Output example

```json
{
  "id": "56619262",
  "title": "Senior Software Engineer",
  "company": "Tech Corp",
  "location": "London",
  "country": "GB",
  "employment_type": "permanent, full-time",
  "remote_option": "hybrid",
  "salary_min": 65000,
  "salary_max": 85000,
  "salary_currency": "GBP",
  "salary_period": "year",
  "salary_text": "GBP 65,000 - 85,000 per year",
  "description_snippet": "We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team...",
  "posted_at": "2026-05-01",
  "expires_at": "2026-06-01",
  "source_url": "https://www.reed.co.uk/jobs/senior-software-engineer/56619262",
  "source_platform": "reed.co.uk",
  "apply_url": "https://www.reed.co.uk/jobs/senior-software-engineer/56619262",
  "search_query": "software engineer in london",
  "scraped_at": "2026-05-04T10:30:00Z"
}
```

## Pricing

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start | $0.001 |
| SERP result (fast mode) | $0.003 |
| Detail result (full mode) | $0.005 |

Typical cost: **$3 per 1,000 jobs** in fast mode, **$5 per 1,000 jobs** in full mode.

## Tips

- **Start small**: Test with `maxResults: 10` before scaling up
- **Use fast mode** for bulk data collection where you only need titles, companies, and salary ranges
- **Use full mode** when you need complete job descriptions or structured salary breakdowns
- **Combine queries**: Use `searchQueries` with multiple keywords to cover related roles in one run
- Results are **automatically deduplicated** across queries

## Limitations

- Reed.co.uk shows a maximum of ~1,000 results per search query
- Some job listings may not include salary information
- Detail page data (full mode) depends on the employer providing structured data
